settingsRepositories.title: Repositories
settingsRepositories.description: Which GitHub repositories are synced and analysed.

docImpact.heading: Documentation impact
docImpact.description: When a pull request touches code that a page here describes, tell its author — and optionally say so in the pull request itself.
docImpact.enabledDescription: In-app, and by email when it merges. Each person can change their own channels in notification settings.
docImpact.commentDescription: One comment per pull request, edited in place as you push. Needs the Aexy GitHub App to have “Pull requests: write”.
docImpact.checkLabel: Add a check to the commit
docImpact.checkDescription: Appears in the pull request's checks list. Needs “Checks: write”.
docImpact.conclusionHint: Neutral by default. A check that fails because a screenshot might be stale tends to get made non-required, and then it is both ignored and red.
docImpact.sharedNote: A pull request comment is one thing every reviewer sees, so this is a workspace setting rather than a personal preference — an individual author cannot opt out of it.
docImpact.adminOnly: Only a workspace admin can change these.
docImpact.saveFailed: Could not save that. Try again.

settingsRepositories.installUrlMissing: GitHub App install URL not configured. Please contact support.
settingsRepositories.autoSyncHint: Automatically sync enabled repositories on a schedule
settingsRepositories.frequencyHint: How often to sync commits, PRs, and reviews
settingsRepositories.reclaimed: Repository reclaimed — sync will resume on the next cycle
settingsRepositories.selectWorkspaceFirst: Select a workspace before adopting repositories
